title.en: An Act Changing the Present Name of the Municipality of Regidor, Occidental Misamis, to Tangub.

text.en:
The municipality of Regidor, Province of Occidental Misamis, shall hereafter be known by the
name of Tangub.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 20, 1930.
